method: Isolated disk-backed Chromium profile; synthetic traffic fully intercepted; four simultaneous responses; GC at checkpoints; ~10ms sampled peaks include JS heap and backing storage. Combined page-world harness, not full installed-extension RAM. RSS sum can double-count shared pages. No real conversations or backend requests.

baseline.notes: Main-world fixture combines extension worlds in one renderer; no real backend. RSS sums include shared pages more than once. Peaks sampled at ~10ms; not a hard RAM cap or multi-day leak test.
